# orbivisor_security_group (Resource)

A security group (firewall rules VM NICs refer to by name).

Manifest kind `SecurityGroup`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orbivisor_security_group" "web" {
  name        = "web"
  description = "HTTP and HTTPS from anywhere"
  rules = [
    { direction = "in", action = "accept", protocol = "tcp", ports = "80" },
    { direction = "in", action = "accept", protocol = "tcp", ports = "443" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `rules` (Dynamic) Rules as a list of objects (the whole list is compared).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
